{{Quote|Over the years, the pair became more and more ambitious, eventually undertaking a daunting mission. They set out to explore the ancient Sith temples on Yavin-Four. Their goal was to investigate the final resting place of Naga Sadow&mdash;one of the most powerful Sith Lords who ever lived.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 7" />}}
In [[3756 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Barel Ovair]] and his [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Eison Gynt]], set out on '''a mission''' to the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]]. The two had spent much time together exploring locations throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that were strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and planned to search the [[Massassi Temple]]s on Yavin 4 and delve into the [[Naga Sadow's tomb|tomb]] of the ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]. Ovair, however, was actually a servant of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|exiled Sith Empire]], on a mission to destroy the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] of long-[[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who might challenge the power of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] upon his return to known [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

After arriving on the moon, Ovair and Gynt were attacked by Sadow's surviving [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors. Defeated, they were forced into the heart of Sadow's tomb, where they were overcome by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] still-lingering [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark energies]]. Ovair was unable to accomplish his objective and so abandoned Gynt there. [[Standard week/Legends|Weeks]] later, he returned to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], claiming Gynt had been killed. However, the young Nautolan survived, only to be possessed by Sadow's spirit and [[Duel on Coruscant (Inter–Sith Wars Period)|killed]] years later by Ovair.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I have long suspected that during this extended period, the Sith spent generations infiltrating Republic political circles and even the Jedi Order.|Gnost-Dural, on the centuries leading up to the Great War|<ref name="Timeline 7" />}}
[[File:NagaSadow.jpg|thumb|left|Naga Sadow on Yavin 4]]
Following the defeat of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] at the conclusion of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] fled the forces of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and sought refuge on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]]. On the moon, Sadow's [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] servants constructed [[Massassi Temple|massive temples]] in the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] honor,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> one of which eventually served as [[Naga Sadow's tomb|his tomb]].<ref name="Timeline 7" /> Meanwhile, other remnants of Sadow's defeated Empire committed themselves to self-imposed exile in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], where they worked to forge a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|new Imperial regime]] led by one of the final living Dark Lords.<ref name="HoloNet Empire">{{Holonet|allegiances|sith-empire|The Sith Empire}}</ref>

This Dark Lord, known only as the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], began preparing his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] for a renewed conflict against the Republic in retribution for the defeat they suffered during the Great Hyperspace War. To that end, the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] dispatched [[Spy/Legends|spies]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to infiltrate the Republic and weaken it from within. Several of these spies were members of the [[Ovair family]]&mdash;Sith who were assigned to masquerade as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and use their position to gain access to the [[Burial/Legends|burial]] grounds of [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]. The Ovairs' mission was to destroy the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] of these Sith to prevent them from challenging the Sith Emperor's power upon his return to the known galaxy.<ref name="Timeline 7" />

[[Barel Ovair]], a third-generation Sith spy, took up the work of his [[Barel Ovair's father|father]] and [[Barel Ovair's grandfather|grandfather]] under the guise of a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Lore Keeper|scholar]]. Alongside his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Eison Gynt]], Ovair traveled the cosmos in search of Sith spirits. Gynt was unaware of his Master's mission, as Ovair had told both his apprentice and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] that the purpose of their travels was to investigate locations strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The two undertook increasingly daring missions<ref name="Timeline 7" /> until [[3756 BBY]]<ref name="news" /> when the elder Jedi decided to take his apprentice to Yavin 4 to explore the Massassi Temples. In reality, however, he planned to infiltrate the ancient crypt of Naga Sadow and destroy the residual traces of the Dark Lord's spirit.<ref name="Timeline 7" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|Gynt and Master Ovair fought bravely against the Massassi, but they were defeated and forced to flee deep into the temple. There, they encountered the dark energies still lingering in Naga Sadow's tomb.|Gnost-Dural, on the mission to Yavin 4|<ref name="Timeline 7" />}}
[[File:NagaSadowTomb-Timeline7.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ovair and Gynt within Sadow's tomb]]
Upon reaching the moon, the two Jedi made their way to the massive temple that housed the Dark Lord's body. Before entering the great structure, they were set upon by hoards of Massassi warriors emerging from the surrounding jungle. These Massassi had survived the centuries since Sadow's death and remained to guard their master's tomb but were twisted by Sadow's [[Sith alchemy/Legends|experimentation]] on them many years before and were now [[Mutant|mutated]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|wielders]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Ovair and Gynt battled into the temple, where they were attacked by even more of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] guards.<ref name="Timeline 7" />

Although the two fought determinedly against the Massassi, they were eventually defeated and forced to retreat into the heart of the temple, where Sadow's sarcophagus was kept. There, they experienced the power of the dark side that still emanated from the Dark Lord's body. However, Ovair failed to destroy Sadow's spirit and fled the moon, abandoning his apprentice within the tomb.<ref name="Timeline 7" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Master Gnost-Dural theorizes that Master Ovair may have been one of the infamous yet still unproven Sith Infiltrators alleged to have been spying on the Jedi Order. Whether that is true or not, clearly there are a great many mysteries surrounding Yavin 4 that remain unsolved.|Grand Master Satele Shan|<ref name="JoMGD">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Wounded_ovair.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Master Ovair returned to Coruscant.]]
Several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the mission, Ovair reappeared at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The false Jedi Master appeared heavily wounded and partially insane due to the ordeal and received intensive care. His recovery process dragged on for an extended period of [[Time/Legends|time]], but Ovair eventually found himself able to make a report of the incident on Yavin 4. In an address to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic, Ovair explained the horrors he had faced on the moon and claimed that Eison Gynt had been killed during their captivity within the tomb. Ovair resumed his post as a Jedi, but several years later, Gynt reappeared on Coruscant, possessed by the spirit of Naga Sadow. He intended to kill Ovair in retribution for his attempt at destroying the Dark Lord's spirit on Yavin 4.<ref name="Timeline 7" />

Gynt [[Duel on Coruscant (Inter–Sith Wars Period)|attacked]] his former Master, but Ovair prevailed in the ensuing duel, killing the Padawan and neutralizing Sadow's specter, thereby fulfilling the edict given to him by the Sith Emperor.<ref name="Timeline 7" /> Around a [[3653 BBY|hundred years later]], in the aftermath of the Sith's [[Great Galactic War|successful campaign]] against the Republic and the Jedi,<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> [[Jedi historian]] [[Gnost-Dural]] investigated the events surrounding the mission to Yavin 4. Gnost-Dural's research revealed Ovair's true allegiances and the purposes for his travels, as well as his family heritage and their contribution to the Empire's war against the Republic.<ref name="Timeline 7" /> [[Satele Shan]], the Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the era, concurred with Gnost-Dural's research and included notes on the mission to Yavin 4 in a [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|wartime journal]] submitted to the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Yavin 4 was first seen in the seventh entry of the [[Galactic Timeline]], an online video series created to elaborate upon the background for the [[LucasArts]]/[[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The entry, titled "[[Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?|Peace for the Republic?]]," was published on [[April 16]], [[2010]], on ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} [http://www.swtor.com official website] and is narrated by actor [[Lance Henriksen]] in his vocal portrayal of Jedi Master Gnost-Dural.<ref name="news" /> "Peace for the Republic?" presents an inconsistency regarding the destruction of Naga Sadow's spirit. Although the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' had previously claimed that the Dark Lord [[Freedon Nadd]] destroyed Sadow's spirit in [[4400 BBY]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|355|Nadd, Freedon}}</ref> the ''Timeline'' indicates that Sadow's spirit was still lingering on Yavin 4 around 644 years later.<ref name="Timeline 7" />
